head: codex/5701-runtime-v3-openapi-contracts
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][api] Define Runtime v3 OpenAPI contracts (#5701)
body:
Closes #5701

## Summary

Defines the complete versioned Runtime v3 Core and Observatory OpenAPI 3.1 contracts and serves them from the guardian-launched Axum/Tokio/Rustls listener. Health, metrics, and Observatory reads are public. Observatory writes require an explicit operator login, and signed control commands remain subject to runtime signature, principal, capability, identity, and command-policy verification. The separate HTML Observatory client supports public live reads plus login, logout, and signed command submission.

## Validation

- Kernel control routes: 21/21 passed.
- OpenAPI contract suite: 6/6 passed.
- Observatory WSS: 6/6 passed, including anonymous feed, real login elevation, pre-login write rejection, post-login signed Snapshot acceptance, invalid-login read continuity, and token-rotation revocation.
- Guardian soak: 7/7 passed after updating the existing test to consume and assert the successful login acknowledgement before independently testing forged-command rejection.
- Strict all-target Clippy passed for adl-runtime-kernel.
- HTML Observatory integrated proof passed.
- Live Guardian served anonymous health, metrics, and Observatory data on port 20997.
- Exact-head GPT-5.5 reviews passed with zero findings for the implementation and bounded CI repair.

## Security boundary

Reads do not require a session token. Writes require login. The browser does not generate or retain a signing key; it transmits a pre-signed command envelope, and Runtime v3 performs the authoritative cryptographic and policy checks.
